CommandSpecDsl - Class in cliwerk.spec
A lightweight, human-friendly text format for describing a picocli CommandLine.Model.CommandSpec, as an alternative to hand-writing JSON.
CommandSpecJson - Class in cliwerk.spec
Reads a picocli CommandLine.Model.CommandSpec from JSON, and writes a CommandLine.Model.CommandSpec to JSON.
CommandSpecMerger - Class in cliwerk.spec
Merges one or more externally-defined CommandLine.Model.CommandSpecs (typically read from JSON with CommandSpecJson.read(String)) into a host ("uber") CommandSpec, each as a subcommand keyed by its own name.
